settings.heading: Our Story
settings.text: Born from a mother's search for safe, beautiful, and effective teething solutions for her little one.

settings.heading: A Journey of Love and Comfort
settings.text:
When our little one began teething, we couldn't find toys that were both completely non-toxic and aesthetically pleasing. Everything was either brightly plastic or didn't soothe their gums effectively.

We decided to design our own. Using food-grade silicone and natural beech wood, Little Creation was born to offer parents peace of mind and babies true comfort.

settings.title: Stimulates senses
settings.text: Sight, sound, and touch all at once. The gentle rattle sparks natural curiosity from 3 months.

settings.title: Soothes every gum
settings.text: Multi-texture ridges reach front, back, and side gums where ordinary teethers can't.

settings.title: Builds motor skills
settings.text: Ergonomic grip sized for tiny hands encourages grasping and transferring milestones.

settings.title: Uncompromising Safety
settings.text: 100% food-grade silicone, BPA-free, and rigorously tested for your absolute peace of mind.
